proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_reservoir
proposed_widenings.justification: The Reserve variant needs persistent item-owned storage for arbitrary incoming spells, later release by the attuned wearer, capacity measured in cumulative spell levels, and replay using the original caster's slot level/DC/attack bonus/spellcasting ability. No existing magic-item family or effect atom can honestly model storing another creature's spell payload and later re-casting it from item state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time.”

proposed_widenings.name: modify_proficiency_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: The Mastery variant changes Proficiency Bonus itself, which propagates into saves, skills, attack bonuses, save DCs, and other derived values. This is broader than any existing roll-only numeric modifier and cannot be represented honestly as a bundle of current atoms without duplicating downstream derivations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.”

proposed_widenings.name: reaction_trigger.creature_casts_spell_visible
proposed_widenings.justification: The Absorption variants trigger on any spell cast by a creature you can see, not on a component-filtered cast within a feet-based range. The current reaction trigger grammar only supports component-scoped spellcasting triggers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see”

proposed_widenings.name: activation_resource.absorbed_spell_levels_pool
proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption and Greater Absorption track burn-out by total spell levels canceled, not by fixed uses or player-spent charges. The pool is consumed by trigger resolution amount equal to triggering spell level, then permanently exhausts at 20.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.”

notes: The collection wrapper and several passive variants fit existing MagicItemRecord variants, but the whole Ioun Stone unit does not fit honestly because Reserve forces a stored-spell lifecycle and Mastery forces proficiency-bonus modification. I did not author placeholder Dhall/JSON/trace files.
